lab.title: Lab Manager
lab.subtitle: One click up and down — watch the attack happen.
lab.desc: Docker-free native Java labs: auto-download server jars and plugins, write configs per recipe, launch and attach the server console to the terminal.
points: Recipe-driven labs: A–H covering offline / proxy / RCON / Query / Log4Shell / permissions
Java provisioning: auto-match JDK per recipe (8 / 11 / 17 / 21)
Live server console, one-click start / stop / reset

run.title: Run Tests
run.subtitle: Pick a chain, fire at the lab, collect evidence.
run.desc: Select an attack chain and an allowlisted target. The step pipeline lights up in real time with dual terminals for engine and server views.
points: Chain engine: conditional branches, per-step evidence, abortable
Dual terminal: engine log left / target server console right
Every step emits evidence breadcrumbs straight into the report
